target_customer: Construction field inspectors, engineering and architecture review firms, general contractors and facility owners
problem: Inspectors spend a large share of their week typing field reports after site visits. Opusense turns voice notes, photos and typed notes into formatted reports on site.
business_model: B2B SaaS mobile and web app (pricing not found)
product_category: AI field inspection reporting for construction and facilities

founders.name: Roya Cody
education: University of Waterloo, PhD civil engineering
Carnegie Mellon University, MSc advanced infrastructure systems
founders.background_notes: YC page: worked as a site inspector and led AI prototypes for phones and laptops.

founders.name: Michael Bacani
education: University of Waterloo, electrical and computer engineering
founders.background_notes: YC page: built AI systems for robotics and self-driving cars.

technical_complexity.rationale: Speech and vision language models turned into structured, offline-capable report templates is mostly application engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Several AI inspection report tools exist (for example InspectMind AI). Firm-branded templates and audit trails create modest lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Construction platforms added AI notes and reports later (OpenSpace Field general availability February 2026, Raken AI features December 2025). Whether this hurt Opusense is not visible.

market_need_then: The YC page says the founders' combined experience exceeds 15 years and report writing took at least 20% of the week; claims are self-reported. Construction documentation was slow to digitize.

branding.domain_note: Uses opusense.com (company site); acquisition history not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Plain functional brand, no press or community evidence found; name could be confused with Opensense.

outcome_analysis: Opusense is an active two person YC Spring 2025 company with founders who include a former site inspector. The company says it is live with multiple North American firms. No exit, shutdown or layoffs were found. Funding beyond YC is unverified, and construction platforms have added similar AI features since.
notes: Funding unverified: one aggregator lists $500K total, pre-seed; no round recorded. Competitor pages found were dated 2025 to 2026, after the May 2025 batch, so list empty. The company site now describes a broader field operations platform than the YC page. Outcome search found nothing on Opusense.
